pages.text: Every living settlement besides the old towns is new: a $(bold)tower$() the survivors raised, a bell, a recruit table, and a town that builds itself out from there. They are small, rough and growing, and they have names.$(br2)Walk into one and the chat tells you whose it is. Write the coordinates down. They are far apart and worth finding.

Each town is a $(bold)faction$(): a leader, a garrison, a treasury, a merchant and a Noble. It farms, mines, trades, sends convoys down the roads, founds new towns when rich and goes to war when it must, whether or not you take part.$(br2)Villagers and soldiers belong to the town whose $(bold)bed$() they sleep in. Everything else follows from that.

$(bold)Reclaiming:$() a recruit table and a bell in a dead village found a new town there, far enough from other towns. The builders put the new over the old.$(br2)No town can be founded or claimed near the capital: it is neutral ground, for everyone.
